courses.summary: 加瓦爾是沙烏地阿拉伯的巨型陸上油田，適合用分區模型研究大尺度集輸與地下不均勻性。本課依序分析長條油藏的分區體積、成熟區含水負荷、遠距集輸的液壓功、多分區計量對帳、分散設施維修物流，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Ghawar is a giant Saudi onshore oil field, a case for compartment models and large gathering systems. The course analyses compartment volumes along an elongated field, water load in mature compartments, hydraulic work in long gathering routes, meter reconciliation across compartments, maintenance logistics for distributed facilities, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
